paragraphs: I'm applying for the Senior Financial Analyst role on the Pharmacy Operations Finance team. I'm an MBA Finance (STEM) candidate at Fordham Gabelli, and before that I spent about five and a half years at JPMorgan Asset Management, Lenovo and Thomson Reuters. I like that this role sits on the capital side of a fast-growing network, where the CapEx plan and the site launch models directly shape where Amazon Pharmacy grows next.

At Lenovo I built forecasts and scenario analyses to evaluate capital allocation, which improved capital efficiency by 15%. At JPMorgan Asset Management I built models to evaluate $10M in marketing-channel budget deployment and quantified ROI across scenarios, and benchmarked past allocations to find 30% efficiency gains that guided reinvestment.

That maps to owning the CapEx forecast, building ROI cases for launches and automation, and keeping the capital request process tight. At Lenovo I also built AI powered dashboards that automated reporting. I'd welcome the chance to talk.
